column1: # eval_manifest.tsv — one row per ablation condition for run_all_evals.sh
#   condition   config_name   checkpoint_dir   state_dim   [extra ablation_eval.py args...]
# - condition is the JSON/output name AND what aggregate_ablation.py keys on. Keep these
#   exact names (rid64 is the paired-delta baseline).
# - checkpoint_dir points at ONE step dir (the 30000 final by default). `run_all_evals.sh
#   sweep <condition>` evals every retained step next to it.
# - $USER is expanded at submit time; EDITME_* placeholders must be replaced with the
#   teammate's username who trained that config (see the shared sheet).
# - base needs NO training: it loads the shared pi0.5 base params with --no-finetuned
#   (NOTE: tyro syntax — NOT "--finetuned false", which crashes).
# - hid is the 6-dim human-only model: state_dim 6 (position-only metrics).
